title.tr: Deck zeminli açık kabin, içinde ahşap bank
title.en: Open timber cabin with a deck floor and a built-in bench

alt.tr: Yatay tahtalarla kaplı açık ahşap kabinin içinde duvara bağlı bir bank, zeminde aralıklı deck tahtaları var
alt.en: Inside an open timber cabin clad in horizontal boards, a bench fixed to the wall and a floor of spaced deck boards

caption.tr: Kabinin zemini aralıklı deck tahtalarından, duvarı yatay kaplamadan oluşuyor. Köşedeki bank duvara sabit.
caption.en: The cabin floor is made of spaced deck boards and the walls of horizontal cladding. The bench in the corner is fixed to the wall.
